verdict.rationale: A probe records an official W&B CLI, but its docs sit under the Models reference path (/models/ref/cli). Nothing in the pack shows that CLI exposes Weave functions such as traces, evaluations or scorers, so credit is minimal. Missing for 10: evidence that the CLI covers Weave operations, CLI command documentation for Weave workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-friendly CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
